name: a numbered step loses its edge
the diagram counts its edges by itself again, apart from the step numbers
find: edges = [(step.number, step.edge) for step in steps.numbered() if step.edge]
replace: edges = [(number, step.edge) for number, step in enumerate((step for step in steps.numbered() if step.edge), 1)]
